name: Indian Political Thriller
description: Machiavellian schemes, elections, and power struggles in Delhi or state capitals.

chapters.title: The Power Broker
chapters.description: Behind-the-scenes dealing; introducing the corrupt but brilliant politician.

chapters.title: The Assassination/Scandal
chapters.description: A major event that creates a power vacuum.

chapters.title: The Idealist
chapters.description: Introduction of the clean protagonist entering the dirty game.

chapters.title: The Coalition
chapters.description: Making unsavory alliances to survive the immediate threat.

chapters.title: The Media Trial
chapters.description: A targeted smear campaign; fighting the narrative.

chapters.title: The Riot/Protest
chapters.description: Engineered chaos to swing public opinion.

chapters.title: The Betrayal of the Mentor
chapters.description: The idealist realizes their patron is the real mastermind.

chapters.title: The Counter-Strike
chapters.description: Using dirty tricks for a 'good' cause; crossing the moral line.

chapters.title: The Election Day
chapters.description: Tension, booth capturing, and manipulating the numbers.

chapters.title: The Floor Test
chapters.description: The climax in the assembly; horse-trading and last-minute flips.

chapters.title: The Cycle Continues
chapters.description: The idealist has become the very thing they fought against.
